newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Central Bank lowers mini-band on real.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Central Bank lowers mini-band on real.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank lowered the mini-band on the real currency for the second time this week by buying dollars at 1.0580 and selling at 1.0630 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set Monday at between 1.0575 and 1.0625 reais per dollar.
The result of the auction represents a 0.05 percent decline from the previous mini-band. Monday's reduction in the mini-band was also a 0.05 percent cut.
The market consensus is that the Central Bank is aiming to depreciate the real by up to 0.6 percent each month. Today's action is within the generally expected pace of reduction in the real.
